definition: A dangerously cheap or botched geneware or wetware modification, typically purchased from unlicensed Shelf-level chop shops. Named for the audible mechanical tremor that sometimes results from improperly integrated hardware interfacing with biological tissue.
usage: Shelf-level fixers, back-alley surgeons, anyone who has been to a chop shop; used as a warning or insult
example: You can hear him coming from twenty meters — full Rattle Splice arm job, sounds like a bag of screws every time he moves.
